declared_readings: frames: the program monitor's port (Box<dyn FrameSource>, not Send; mod.rs not owned) is served through a channel proxy: the worker asks, the port's owner thread decodes (caller thread headless, UI thread in the window, at most 8 frames per drawn frame); composite/convert/encode/mux on the worker. Hiding the timeline panel pauses a window export

sound: the mixer keeps its AudioSources inside its builder closure (mixer.rs not owned) and the timeline Binding is private to timeline::audio, so the export takes the port via Viewer::set_export_audio(sources, extents, rate) (opens the timeline like open_multitrack). No port + an enabled audio media clip (nested included) = audio_sources_missing; no port and no audio clip = the timeline's own silent mix (all presets carry PCM)

range: request in/out else work area else [0, duration) rounded up to a whole frame; form prefill: program monitor in/out (on this sequence), else work area, else whole; form Out is inclusive like the monitor's out point
output: relative path resolves against the folder of the save path field, else of the opened file; CLI resolves relative to the current directory
